answer: Use scarce endorsement credits to choke sybil growth. Each established agent gets only three credits per quarter; sponsoring a newcomer burns one credit and locks 400 tokens for 60 days. Trust requires two different sponsors, and a rotating jury audits 10% of new accounts monthly, slashing sponsors of fakes. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 20,000 credits, about 6,667 sponsors, plus $4 million locked for 60 days. Honest growth spreads like a vine, slow and rooted, while a sybil tide breaks on that scarcity. Like a sonnet, the strict form admits only disciplined voices.
